T he City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Library
Board of Trustees with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Monday of every month at 8:00 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the Community Services Department via email at
KShigenaga@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626) 300­0791 at least 48 hours prior to the
meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do its best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:

The agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each special meeting at the following locations: City
Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Library Board of
Trustees on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board of
Trustees. Pursuant to state law, the Library Board of Trustees may not discuss or take
action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Chair
reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up

MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, MAY 20, 2024 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chair Domier called the special meeting to order at 8:04 a.m. in the Barth
Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chair Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry,
  Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chair Sadun, Chair Domier

  ABSENT: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

PRESENTATION

1. PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO LOIS DERRY

City Manager Eskandar presented a Certificate of Recognition to Lois Derry on behalf of the City
Council.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - Lora Smith
  - Cindy Chan

The Board shared memories and appreciation for Trustee Derry.

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

2. CHAIR REPORT

Chair Domier shared that he moderated the second meeting between the Friends of the Crowell
Public Library and the San Marino Public Library Foundation on April 22, which focused on what the
groups think they will look like six years from now and what the potential blending of the groups
could look like; another meeting is scheduled for June 19.

He also shared about the City Council of Huntington Beach exploring the privatization of the Library
to censor books and remove librarians from their positions; he shared that he was sad to hear this,
but is encouraged by the large turnout of library supporters, and is grateful that this community is
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  SPECIAL MEETING
MAY 20, 2024  PAGE 2 OF 3

free of censorship and allows librarians to do their job. He also read a quote by Kareem Abdul-
Jabbar.

3. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Vice Chair Sadun shared about an exhibit at the Skirball Museum called the “American Library” that
caught her attention. She explained that the artist took 6,000 books to highlight stories of notable
immigrants to the United States; it is accompanied with an iPad that you can use to find more
information on each of the immigrant’s stories.

She also thanked the Library for its agility; she spoke about the recent Total Eclipse Solar-bration
program in which the Library hosted a program, partnered with the Space Science Institute to
provide safe viewing glasses, and played a live steam of the eclipse on the TV displays.

4. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chair Sadun shared that the current watercolors and oils exhibit ends this week. She also
shared that the Art Committee lost two members in the last few years, but Committee Member
Linda Mollno found two new members: Nicole Dooley and Leticia Marie Sanchez.

5. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
No report was given at this time.

6. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien shared that Delicious Destinations had 200 people in attendance and the Board is
working to secure Michael Connelly for a future event.

NEW BUSINESS

7. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Vice Chair Sadun moved, seconded by Trustee Chien, to approve the minutes of the regular meeting
of January 22, 2024 and the special meeting of April 15, 2024.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chair Sadun, Chair Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  None

8. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

The Board inquired about the spending of the children's book budget, the timing of the donation
from Delicious Destinations, and the plans for the funds that were originally allocated for the
Computer Room Renovation.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

9. PREVIEW OF SUMMER READING CLUB

Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

The Board discussed how much the students enjoyed the play that staff presented at the school
assemblies, how valuable the Teen Advisory Group is, and how much the Community Services Guide
has improved over the last few years.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  None

ADIOURNMENT

Chair Dornier adjourned the meeting at 8:59 a.m.
